description: This file defines the AWS OrganizationsClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with AWS Organizations service, including operations like creating, deleting, and describing organizational units, policies, and accounts.

classes.name: OrganizationsClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Organizations service, providing methods for organizational management operations.

methods.name: acceptHandshake
methods.description: Accepts a handshake request in AWS Organizations.

methods.name: attachPolicy
methods.description: Attaches a policy to an AWS Organizations entity.

methods.name: describeCreateAccountStatus
methods.description: Describes the status of an account creation request.

methods.name: describeEffectivePolicy
methods.description: Describes the effective policy for an entity.

methods.name: detachPolicy
methods.description: Detaches a policy from an entity.

methods.name: enableAllFeatures
methods.description: Enables all features in the organization.

methods.name: inviteAccountToOrganization
methods.description: Invites an account to the organization.

methods.name: listAWSServiceAccessForOrganization
methods.description: Lists AWS services enabled for the organization.

methods.name: listChildren
methods.description: Lists child entities of a parent.

methods.name: listCreateAccountStatus
methods.description: Lists the status of account creation requests.

methods.name: listDelegatedServicesForAccount
methods.description: Lists delegated services for an account.

methods.name: listOrganizationalUnitsForParent
methods.description: Lists organizational units under a parent.

methods.name: listPoliciesForTarget
methods.description: Lists policies attached to a target.

methods.name: moveAccount
methods.description: Moves an account to a different parent.

methods.name: removeAccountFromOrganization
methods.description: Removes an account from the organization.
